name: will-to-save-rest-prep
notes: Will to Save (qUd2uwAPvh, GeneratedMacroCode.php cardActivatedAbilities["qUd2uwAPvh:0"] / customDQHandlers["qUd2uwAPvh:0:CardActivated-1"]): "You may rest your champion. If you do, put a preparation counter on them." Playing the card from hand (1 reserve, paid from hand) offers a YES/NO prompt to rest the champion (who starts unrested, Status=2); answering YES rests the champion (Status becomes 1) and adds a preparation counter. Break/restore verified: commenting out the RestCard() call in CardActivated-1 leaves the champion's Status at 2 and the fixture fails; restoring it passes again.

rulesClauses: You may rest your champion. If you do, put a preparation counter on them.
